page.overview:
Who is Animal control officer?

The animal control officer captured Momo and three pygmy pumas and attempted to sell them to a butcher, who intended to use them as food. However, before this deal was finalized, Momo was able to open his cage, as the animal control officer had left the key in the lock, and escape along with the pygmy pumas, whom he freed as well. The officer and butcher soon returned to the cells to find them empty.
